topic: After SP-024 merges, existing placed content stays in the base until relabelled
detail: Chunks stored before SP-024 (including those SP-023 placed in a space) stay in the base collection; new writes go to space collections. Until SP-027's 'orch rag relabel' moves them, they are found only by searches that read every collection (today's default) or 'shared'. A docs file or source file that did not change is not written again (RC-124), so it is not moved by a sync either. Nothing to do while no policy is applied; with one applied, run the relabel once SP-027 lands.
